sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Widgets, For You, characters, icons and accent, iPad layout

- WidgetKit extension: Continue Watching (small/medium) and Airing Today
  (medium/large); app shares data through the App Group container and
  deep links via anixq://title/<slug> and anixq://schedule
- 'Для вас' shelf from titles similar to what the user watches
- Characters and key staff from Shikimori on the title page
- Alternate app icons and accent colour picker in Settings
- Option to show subtitles for dubs when available
- Larger hero/header and readable text width on iPad
